problem: "Denser particles move outward" does not say denser than what. A student can read it as denser particles in general and miss the case of particles lighter than the liquid, which move inward.
fix: "Particles denser than the liquid move outward and settle as a pellet; particles lighter than the liquid move inward."

problem: "so one tube gives different forces on different rotors" is unclear: the same tube sits at a different radius in different rotors, and that is why the force changes.
fix: "The same tube sits at a different radius in different rotors, so the same rpm gives a different RCF."

problem: The symbols d, Δρ and η are named but their units are not given. The formula is only valid in consistent units, so a student may put d in µm or Δρ in g/cm³ and get a wrong answer.
fix: Add: "Use SI units: d in m, Δρ in kg/m³, η in Pa·s (kg/(m·s)), ω in rad/s, r in m; v then comes out in m/s."

problem: The chapter has just shown that rpm alone does not fix the force, yet the protocol is given only in rpm. On a rotor of different radius this range gives a different force.
fix: Give the force as well: "about 1000–1500 × g for 10 min (roughly 3000 rpm at a 15 cm radius)."
